title: A Salaam daemon's AgentPod pins file
description: What binds a Salaam daemon to one AgentPod organization, node and station: `~/.config/salaam/agentpod-pins.json` by default, or `--agentpod-config`, written by `salaam host bind` and read by the daemon at start (salaam:src/agentpod/authority.ts readAgentPodPins, src/agentpod/default-config.ts, src/host/bind.ts). AgentPod's node-agent reads `workspace` from it to find the station (agentpod:apps/node-agent/internal/descriptor/salaamharness/salaam_discover.go). An owner-only file of at most 16 KiB with exactly these keys. Beyond the shape, `station_key` must be `salaam:` and the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of `workspace`, `workspace` its own canonical real path, and the daemon's state directory outside it. Every admission's binding must carry these same values.
